    def finish_set_play(self) -> None:
        if self.game["state"] != "playing" or self.game["setPlay"] == "noSetPlay":
            return
        self.automatic_set_play = False
        self.game["droppedBall"] = False
        self.game["secondaryTime"] = 0
        self.game["setPlay"] = "noSetPlay"
        self.game["kickingSide"] = None
        self.game["stopped"] = False
        self.pending_publish = True

    def finish_half(self, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
        if self.game["state"] not in ("ready", "set", "playing"):
            return
        self.game["secondaryTime"] = 0
        self.game["setPlay"] = "noSetPlay"
        self.game["kickingSide"] = None
        self.game["droppedBall"] = False
